news.t: Carabao Cup quarterfinal draw: Liverpool to face Bournemouth
news.desc: Liverpool will host fellow Premier League side Bournemouth in the Carabao Cup quarterfinals after making it past Chelsea in a penalty shootout on Wednesday.

news.t: Liverpool beat Chelsea in shootout to reach Carabao Cup quarters
news.desc: Liverpool saw off Chelsea in another Carabao Cup penalty shootout as former Reds midfielder Xabi Alonso suffered his third defeat as a manager at Anfield.

news.t: Man City survive penalties to advance past Brighton
news.desc: Manchester City's backup goalkeeper Gerónimo Rulli saved two spot-kicks as the holders beat Brighton 4-3 on penalties to edge into the Carabao Cup quarterfinals.
